card.name: Digits inside section and volume numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit right after a section number's dot or a classification code, such as 12.<<3>> or O3<<3>>. It also fires on the leading digit of a journal volume or year.

modes.label: Label section cross-references
modes.description: The digit after the dot in a numbered section reference, such as 12.3, in drug label text.

modes.label: Classification codes
modes.description: The digit within a subject code like O33 or O11 in economics category lists.

modes.label: Citation volume or year digit
modes.description: The first digit of a volume number or year in a reference entry.

card.plain: It marks a digit inside a numbered section, code or volume, where another digit usually comes next.
